g.text: Illustrative, from Section 3.7. W = 121, L = 96, u(w) = √w, c(0) = 0, c(1) = 1, and the premium is the zero-profit indemnity at a = 1. At α*, the agent is willing to take high prevention; smaller α unravels to a = 0.
